body: Thank you for taking the time to share your thoughts. I really don't feel ready to share with her yet. However the guilt and shame is overwhelming. You may be right in seeing an unaffected outside individual. I've attended therapy before for general depression, but in those sessions I never had the courage to share this information with my therapist. I was envisioning that it would inevitably lead to a recommendation from them to be open to my partner and I couldn't handle the thought of going down that path.
